name: elevenlabs
summary: Completed the ElevenLabs quickstart end-to-end. Installed the elevenlabs and python-dotenv packages, created the example script, and successfully generated an MP3 audio file from text using the ElevenLabs Text-to-Speech API. The output file `output.mp3` (43,511 bytes) was verified as a valid MPEG ADTS layer III MP3 at 128 kbps, 44.1 kHz, monaural.
deviations: 1. The quickstart's `play(audio)` call was replaced with saving to a file (`output.mp3`) because the sandbox has no audio output/speakers. 2. No `.env` file was created because `ELEVENLABS_API_KEY` was already exported as an environment variable in the sandbox.

verified.evidence: output.mp3: Audio file with ID3 version 2.4.0, contains: MPEG ADTS, layer III, v1, 128 kbps, 44.1 kHz, Monaural

friction.detail: Fetched quickstart URL returns dense HTML navigation noise instead of readable quickstart steps or code examples. Quote: 'ElevenAPI quickstart | ElevenLabs Documentation For AI agents: a documentation index is available at the root level at /llms.txt. Append /llms.txt to any URL for a page-level index, or .md for the markdown version of any page. Search / Connect Blog Help Center API Pricing Sign up Overview ElevenCreative ElevenAgents ElevenAPI Reception.ai API reference Changelog Help Center Login Overview ElevenCreative ElevenAgents ElevenAPI Reception.ai API reference Changelog Help Center Get started Quickstart Agents Quickstart Choosing the right model Tutorials'

The official quickstart uses a play(audio) helper that fails in headless sandboxes, forcing users to manually rewrite the example to save to a file. Quote: 'The quickstart's `play(audio)` call was replaced with saving to a file (`output.mp3`) because'

The example script expects ELEVENLABS_API_KEY via dotenv but the transcript never shows creating the .env file or exporting the variable, leaving the credential step undocumented. Quote: 'load_dotenv()... api_key=os.getenv(\"ELEVENLABS_API_KEY\"),'

friction.where: Markdown version hint buried in HTML
friction.detail: The docs mention that appending .md or /llms.txt yields clean, machine-readable content, but this is buried in the fetched HTML noise so developers may miss it. Quote: 'For AI agents: a documentation index is available at the root level at /llms.txt. Append /llms.txt to any URL for a page-level index, or .md for the markdown version of any page.'
